purpose: PostgreSQL ingestion contract for derived FCHMA dataset assets so runtime and research layers can share the same normalized shapes.
notes: These tables store derived assets only, not original raw workbooks.
They preserve a stable path from source respondent or supporter rows into field facts, narrative units, projection facts, and manifold-ready profiles.
They are intentionally provider-agnostic and suitable for both offline research and runtime case materialization.

tables.grain: one row per dataset version and ingestion build
runtime_uses: Track which derived dataset build seeded runtime imports
Preserve manifest and provenance references for audit
research_uses: Version control for analysis-ready and manifold-ready assets

columns.name: id
columns.description: Deterministic batch identifier generated from lane, dataset, and version.

columns.name: manifold_recipe_json
columns.description: Recipe emitted by manifold input generation.

columns.name: source_manifest_json
columns.description: Tracked source manifest describing the secure original workbook.

tables.grain: one row per respondent or supporter row within a dataset batch
runtime_uses: Bridge a survey respondent into case materialization later
Keep lane-aware provenance before creating cases
research_uses: Stable subject-level join key across fields, narratives, projections, and manifold profiles

columns.name: subject_key
columns.description: Original respondent_id from the derived assets.

columns.name: source_record_count
columns.description: Count of structured source rows tied to the subject.

columns.name: narrative_unit_count
columns.description: Count of narrative units tied to the subject.

columns.name: metadata_json
columns.description: Subject-level provenance, row span, and source identifiers.

tables.grain: one row per normalized field observation
runtime_uses: Populate survey_import case inputs without rereading the original workbook
research_uses: Filtered structured analysis by response type and question group
Similarity feature generation from normalized field facts

columns.name: source_row_index
columns.description: Original row index in the analysis-ready export.

columns.name: response_type
columns.description: identifier, ordinal, multiselect, free_text, and related meaning types.

columns.name: raw_value_text
columns.description: Original normalized text payload before later modeling.

columns.name: payload_json
columns.description: Field payload including normalized value and manual review markers.

tables.grain: one row per free-text unit extracted from a dataset subject
runtime_uses: Seed narrative_units when materializing a case from survey data
Keep evidence-text traceability separate from summaries
research_uses: Narrative retrieval and later embedding jobs
Chain extraction experiments without reopening raw workbooks

columns.name: unit_index
columns.description: Sequence number within the source field.

columns.name: content_hash
columns.description: Stable content hash for cache reuse.

tables.grain: one row per deterministic projection candidate
runtime_uses: Seed case-side ICF or supporter-side planning hints before model-backed reasoning
Preserve candidate status rather than final judgment
research_uses: Compare structured and narrative projection coverage

columns.name: secondary_axis
columns.description: Optional secondary frame for respondent-side projections.

columns.name: payload_json
columns.description: Matched pattern, label text, and extra projection context.

tables.grain: one row per subject-level manifold-ready representation
runtime_uses: Seed lightweight similarity search and related-case suggestions later
Keep a compact numeric and sparse profile outside the raw source row table
research_uses: Local manifold, clustering, and nearest-neighbor experiments
Future pgvector or external vector migration once dimensions are finalized

columns.name: numeric_feature_count
columns.description: Count of numeric feature keys present.

columns.name: recipe_json
columns.description: Manifold recipe metadata and cost-control notes.
